# A5X Industries Pvt Ltd

> India's robotics, AI, drone, 3D printing and automation company based in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh. We build intelligent solutions for education, defense, agriculture and industry. 500+ students trained, 50+ projects delivered.

A5X Industries Pvt Ltd (A5X) is an Indian technology company founded in 2023 and headquartered in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh. The company specializes in robotics, artificial intelligence systems, drones (including FPV drones), 3D printing and modeling, and industrial automation. A5X also provides robotics workshops and training, having trained over 500 students and delivered more than 50 projects.

## Services

- Robotics Development: design and build of robots and robotic systems for education, defense, agriculture and industry.
- AI Systems: artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions, computer vision and IoT systems.
- Drone Solutions: FPV drones and drone systems for various applications.
- 3D Printing & Modeling: 3D printing, 3D modeling and 3D design services.
- Industrial Automation: automation solutions for industry.
- Robotics Workshops & Training: hands-on robotics, AI and automation training for students and professionals.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2023
- Location: Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, India
- Area served: India
- Students trained: 500+
- Projects delivered: 50+
